reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate. (1) Vacuous prediction_if_true: the coordinate projections x1, x2, x3 of S_3 in (P^1)^3 are already elliptic fibrations with parameter bidegree (1,0)/(0,1) <= (1,1); the standard presentation satisfies 'bidegree <=(1,1)' trivially, so 'some fibration has bidegree <=(1,1)' cannot be false. Needs 'non-coordinate, non-Moebius-equivalent to a coordinate projection' and a genuine NS-lattice classification of fibrations (Oguiso's 11 types for Km(E1xE2) non-isogenous, extra types for E x E / Kuwata-Shioda). (2) No defined object to descend: the subspace condition is x1,x2 in V (F_2-subspace) and R fixed; a new fibre parameter t=phi(x1,x2) is a function on the surface, but x1,x2 are not functions of t, so conditions 'descend' only if the system is re-presented with t as an extra variable. The experiment never specifies that polynomial system, so 'compare msolve degrees with standard S_3' compares nothing. (3) No null/control arm: no matched-random system, no Moebius-relabel control (ffd_semaev_core.random_matched exists but unused). (4) Toy params inconsistent: p=65537 has n=1 (no Weil descent; fpn_degrees supports only p<46341, n<=3), F_{2^11} is below the stated n=13..19; mixing prime and binary arms with one l range. (5) Success metric 'degree' is ambiguous (parameter bidegree vs msolve F4 max deg vs d_F); only d_ff / msolve step table / hky_last_fall_degree d_F are structural and acceptable; wall time must not be used. (6) Scaling: a >=1 degree drop at n=17..19 is a fixed-n datum; says nothing at n=131 unless measured as a slope in (n,l) and shown independent of presentation; m=2 (S_3 only) is also the regime where programme already closed subspace shape ('factor-base subspace shape at m=2'), and d_ff=2 constant of presentation. Part A (bidegree classification) is pure algebra and cheap; Part B is meaningful only after redesign. Expected outcome per Bezout/transport-conservation: relabelling.
fix: Two-stage falsifier. STAGE A (symbolic, <2 CPU-min, PARI/sympy, no msolve): build S_3(x1,x2,x3) over Q(a,b) or over F_p with E fixed; compute NS-relevant data: enumerate elliptic fibrations by pencils of low bidegree: all parameters t=(a x1x2+b x1+c x2+d)/(e x1x2+f x1+g x2+h) (bidegree (1,1)) and, for the third coordinate, t in {x3, x1+x2-type via S_3 symmetry}; test which pencils have generic fibre of arithmetic genus 1 (compute fibre curve genus via gp: resultant/ discriminant, or count points over F_p for p=101,1009 and compare with Hasse/ellcard of fibre) and reject any pencil Moebius-equivalent to a coordinate projection (x1,x2,x3 up to PGL2 on that factor). Record the list of NON-trivial bidegree<=(1,1) fibrations (including Kuwata-Shioda from the Inose-type / Oguiso J-types for E x E, via the 2-isogeny/sum-difference maps t=x(P+Q)... x(P-Q) combos). If the list is empty, verdict relabelling is final with obstruction = fibre-class degree in NS(Km(E x E)); stop (no Stage B). STAGE B (only if Stage A non-empty), binary arm only, F_{2^n}, n=13,15,17,19 (primes), l=4,5,6, m=2 and m=3 (S_4 via resultant) using ffd_semaev_core.build_system / hky_last_fall_degree: ARMS = (i) standard descended S_3 in x1,x2,xR; (ii) augmented system adding t as new unknown with relation t*den(x1,x2)+num(x1,x2)=0 (same ideal, different presentation), x1,x2 in V unchanged; (iii) NULL: same augmentation with t=a Moebius image of x1 (known relabelling, must show no degree change); (iv) NULL: ffd_semaev_core.random_matched(eqs) system of identical shape. METRICS (counted/structural, not time): d_ff, hky d_F (closure_dims), msolve -v 2 -g 2 max F4 deg and #zero reductions, Macaulay rank/cols at fixed D. PREDICTION_IF_TRUE: arm (ii) shows d_F or F4 max-deg strictly below arm (i) AND below arm (iii) by >=1 at >=2 of n in {15,17,19}, with the gap non-decreasing in l and n over >=3 values of n (slope data, 30+ seeds per cell, report Wilson CI). PREDICTION_IF_FALSE: arm (ii) == arm (iii) within seed noise. Drop p=65537 prime arm (n=1, no descent); if a prime arm is wanted use fpn_degrees GF(p,n) with p<46341, n=2,3 and system_labels D_GB/D_sat. SCALING CLAIM must be stated as: only a gap that is stable or growing in (n,l) is evidence for n=131; a fixed-n constant drop is classified 'engineering/constant factor' per rule 5 (B*D^2 << N not approached). Budget fits 20 CPU-min: Stage A ~2 min, Stage B n<=19, l<=6, m=2 each cell sub-second to seconds; m=3 only at n<=15 if msolve exceeds budget.
collisions: Closed: factor-base subspace shape at m=2 (atlas); first fall degree is a constant of the presentation (d_ff=2 always) so arm (ii) likely cannot move d_ff; only d_F is a live metric
Transport conservation / Bezout-type degree conservation: a P^1 or Moebius reparametrisation is a relabelling (arm iii control)
Overlaps open lever 1 (growth of last fall degree, KN-OPEN-8f3d27 family) - results should be filed there as a presentation-sensitivity datum, not as a new route
